title: different BG readings
symptom: The user is using xDrip+ with MiaoMiao and reports that the BG readings from the app are different from the official Libre scanner, and asks if there is a way to make xDrip+ use the same algorithm as the official scanner.
cause: xDrip allows different algorithms to calculate BG readings, which can result in differences from the official Libre scanner.
fix: To get results similar to the scanner, the user is directed to use the LibreOOPAlgorithm (https://github.com/tzachi-dar/LibreOOPAlgorithm).
evidence_quote: xdrip allows different algorithms to calculate bg readings. To get results similar to the scanner, please see https://github.com/tzachi-dar/LibreOOPAlgorithm
